detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Bird Game 3 is real!

It's real and it's back! After years of waiting, Bird Game 3 has arrived on Steam. The game that defined a generation. The lobbies that broke friendships.

Immersive BvB (Bird vs. Bird)

Fly. Fight. Survive. Protect your eggs at all costs.

Classic Multiplayer Chaos

Experience the lobbies your parents warned you about. Voice chat included. Mute button optional.

Customize your Bird

Decide what your Bird will look like. Cowboy hat or ski goggles. Your Bird really got some style!

Flock up!

Team up with your friends and experience Bird Game 3's Multiplayer together! Experience the Chaos we all loved, now new and enhanced!

If you know, you know. If you don't – you're about to find out.

"Kids today wouldn't survive these lobbies." – Everyone who played Bird Game 2 in 2016
